release_notes:
Translate common UI labels across all languages (buttons, statuses, generic labels)

Extended the label backfill to translate the recurring UI vocabulary — buttons
(Save, Cancel, Delete, Search, Submit, ...), statuses (Pending, Completed, Rejected,
...), generic labels (Name, Email, Password, Date, Status, Amount, Price, ...) and a
few common confirmation messages — across all 15 supported languages, for both admin
and client language files.

SAFETY: order/API-related terms are hard-blocklisted and were NOT translated — IMEI,
IMEI Type, Single IMEI, Bulk IMEIs, Model, Model No., Brand, Network, MEP, Carrier,
Serial, Pin Code, Provider, Operator, etc. remain in English so nothing that flows
into order building/display changes. Custom-field labels and API field names come from
the database (not language constants), so they are untouched regardless. Only labels
that were still an untranslated English fallback were filled; existing translations
were never overwritten (verified). Remaining domain-specific labels keep the English
fallback and can be translated later.
